title: AgentRunState
description: Params of the agent.runState server-to-client notification (nocx-x8s2.2, design §7): the run's terminal state. A renderer that reconnects mid-answer reads the run's state and its appended chunks from the ledger; it never infers liveness from notifications having stopped. error is present ONLY for failed, and it is a sentence a person reads — never a Go error string.

runId.description: The backend-minted run id whose state changed.

state.description: The run's state, exactly as the renderer draws it (design §7). This notification carries a terminal state: completed | cancelled | failed | interrupted.

error.description: The reason, present only for failed: a sentence a person reads ('the endpoint's credential is unavailable — unlock the vault'), never a Go error string.
